node.title: E22 overlap residual-profile formula
node.statement: For every dyadic pair M_i<M_j, count exactly the canonical minimal-scale-M_i E22 support data whose scale-M_i tail and incomplete-M_j-parent residual profile satisfy the raw M_j admissibility inequality from e22_overlap_nested_fiber_residual_identity, with the declared dyadic_profile_evaluation multiplicity. This is reduced to the proved residual generating function and the remaining lower-scale minimality/multiplicity filter.
node.attack_surface: assembly from the residual generating function and the remaining minimality/multiplicity filter
node.falsifier: a minimal-scale-M_i support whose residual profile is counted with the wrong binomial coefficient or multiplicity
